expected.finding: **[P1]** Quoted JSON credentials survive redaction and enter policy PRs. In [improvement_policy.py:105](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/improvement_policy.py:105), the regex does not allow a closing quote between a credential’s key and colon. Consequently, `{"password": "[REDACTED]"}` remains unchanged. A reproduction with five failed connection attempts carried the synthetic password through the trace report into the proposed policy’s `mined_from` entries. These are pushed before human approval. Handle quoted credential fields before allowing trace text into published artifacts.

**[P2]** Repeated failures backdate newly observed evidence. In [mine-trace-failures.py:281](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/mine-trace-failures.py:281), later diagnostics are appended to `_text`, but the record retains the first occurrence’s timestamp. `build_evidence()` then assigns that timestamp to every matching topic. Reproducing a generic failure at time 10 followed by matching “session expired” diagnostics at time 20 incorrectly produced an authentication-failure count of one at time 15. Preserve occurrence timestamps and derive each topic’s earliest actual match before deduplicating.
